objective: Add one canonical ERP fact to Distributor Status and expose a strictly read-only ERP Partner Viewer scoped to assigned ERP systems while preserving existing operational, renewal, and financial authorities.

humanGate.reason: Owner must manually apply reviewed Migration 047 after exact-head product and database verification; Codex remains read-only against production Supabase.

budgets.dataAuthority: ERP identity is public.erp_systems; Distributor ERP assignment is distributor_accounts.erp_id; renewal remains distributor_accounts.renewal_date; financial authority remains receivables plus effective receivable_payments; ERP scopes are authorization only.
budgets.readBudget: Internal and external list endpoints apply ERP/search/state filters server-side before pagination, cap pages at 50 rows, and resolve import ERP keys in bounded chunks without per-row network queries.
budgets.writeBudget: Admin-authorized Distributor commands/imports may resolve or create one canonical ERP and patch distributor_accounts.erp_id; scope management writes only erp_partner_scopes. No migration backfill or financial write is permitted.
budgets.rlsModel: ERP tables and all ERP read/scope RPCs are service-role only; external visibility is enforced inside security-definer functions by active capability plus exact scope, never by client filtering or base-table exposure.
budgets.indexRequirements: Unique erp_systems.erp_key plus distributor ERP/update and ERP/renewal indexes; no ERP column or index is added to Receivables or Payments.
budgets.failureMode: Unknown ERP, invalid mixed capability, active employee assignments, stale import plans, missing scope, or authority errors fail closed without partial authority changes.
budgets.concurrencyModel: Deterministic ERP IDs, unique normalized keys, existing Distributor versions/import transactions, assignment triggers, and atomic scope RPCs protect concurrent writes.
budgets.idempotencyModel: Exact normalized ERP keys reuse canonical IDs; existing Distributor and Master Workbook operation/request/resolved-plan hashes remain authoritative; financial idempotency remains Migration 046.
budgets.testPlan: Focused parser/planner/auth/API tests, Distributor E2E, GitHub PostgreSQL 17.6 fresh-apply and database invariants, exact-head product verification/build, Vercel Preview, and read-only production pre/postchecks.

acceptance.description: Create canonical ERP and exclusive ERP Partner access authorities, service-only scope management, and database assignment exclusion without backfill or duplicate business authority.

Integrate ERP create/update/preserve/clear semantics into manual Distributor editing, legacy Distributor import, and versioned Master Workbook V2 with resolved-plan hashing and explicit V1 upgrade failure.

Project and server-filter the same canonical ERP fact across Distributor Status, Renewals, Distributor Collections, invoice Payment Collections, and applicable exports without duplicating financial or renewal facts.
Provide a minimal read-only, server-scoped ERP Partner portal, account/scope management, auth isolation, safe navigation, and explicit denial of internal and financial APIs.

Preserve existing Distributor, Renewal, Receivable, Payment, import, numeric-wire and Master Workbook authorities; update contracts, Graph authorities/capabilities, and compile the six requested lessons.
Focused unit, database, E2E, typecheck, lint, build, exact-head CI and Vercel Preview evidence proves the high-value ERP authority, propagation, security, isolation and compatibility invariants.

Prepare Migration 047 owner SQL, hash, read-only precheck, schema/security delta, zero-backfill and zero-financial-mutation statements, postcheck and forward-only recovery; stop at OWNER_PRODUCTION_GATE.
